# Wounds
## Tend Wounds Tend Bruise Wounds and Tend Burn Wounds heal brute or burn damage on one part without topicals. Make a careful incision, then repair the tissue with a hemostat. The repair keeps going until the part is healed. When it's done, the window moves you on to closing the incision with a cautery.
Bleeding wounds can't be tended. Stop the bleeding first with gauze or the Stop Bleeding operation. A part with organ damage or a severed limb won't heal either until that is fixed.
## Cavity Implant Hides a tiny or small item inside the torso. Open the incision and the ribcage first, then hold the item and insert it.
